create_TriFingerPlatform_simulation: create a TriFingerPlatform simulation with visualization enabled and a colored cube object type
reset_TriFingerPlatform: reset the TriFingerPlatform simulation with a new initial object pose and robot position
append_desired_action: append a desired action to the TriFingerPlatform and log the robot observation and object pose
get_camera_observation: get the camera observation at a given time step from the TriFingerPlatform simulation
store_action_log: store the TriFingerPlatform action log to a pickle file with final object pose data
